title: 4521-ESP-ANC-00-60-N185 Specification for Field Applied Paint
summary:
- Document covers field applied paint specifications for Job No. 120006 in Solana project.
- Notices include alternate billing cycle, extended payment, and certification provisions.
- Confidentiality of information is strictly enforced.
- Instructions require initialing on cover sheet and identifying revisions in the body.
- Scope covers surface preparation and application of coatings and paint.
- General requirements include field assembly, material delivery, storage, labor provision, adherence to codes, conflict resolution, and safety measures.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles, extended payment and certification periods.
- Paint application restricted to dry surfaces at temperatures above dew point.
- Surface preparation includes masking, sandblasting, and cleaning.

- Confidentiality terms restrict use and disclosure of information.
- The contract allows for alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
summary_points: Document covers field applied paint specifications for Job No. 120006 in Solana project.
Notices include alternate billing cycle, extended payment, and certification provisions.
Confidentiality of information is strictly enforced.
Instructions require initialing on cover sheet and identifying revisions in the body.
Scope covers surface preparation and application of coatings and paint.
General requirements include field assembly, material delivery, storage, labor provision, adherence to codes, conflict resolution, and safety measures.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles, extended payment and certification periods.
Paint application restricted to dry surfaces at temperatures above dew point.
Surface preparation includes masking, sandblasting, and cleaning.
Different procedures for various types of steel surfaces (carbon, stainless, pre-painted).
Confidentiality terms restrict use and disclosure of information.
The contract allows for alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Painting surfaces must be prepared using solvent cleaning, air blast, or brush blast.
Touch-up painting is required for shop-painted items with damaged areas.
Quality control involves visual inspection of surface preparation and paint application.
Environmental conditions must not affect the quality of the finished product.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Owner can request payment within 180 days after certification and approval.
Owner can certify and approve billings and estimates within 30 days.
Confidential information is protected by contract terms.
Painted surfaces must meet film thickness and workmanship specifications.
Defective or unacceptable work requires prompt correction.
Final touch-up required before leaving the job site.
Surface preparation details are specified in Section 3 of this specification.
